youtube.title: Why There's a Tiny Arrow on Your Fuel Gauge ⛽ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
On most newer cars, the fuel gauge has a small triangle arrow next to the fuel pump symbol. That arrow points to the side of the car where the fuel filler cap is. It's especially handy in a rental or borrowed car, so you know which side of the pump to pull up to without getting out to check. Older cars often don't have it, and on some the pump icon's hose side hints the same.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy

sources: Automaker owner's manuals (Ford, Toyota): the arrow beside the fuel gauge icon indicates the fuel filler door side
